item.title: Qodo 2.1 solves your coding agents' 'amnesia' problem, giving them an 11% precision boost
item.description: As AI-powered coding tools flood the market, a critical weakness has emerged: by default, as with most LLM chat sessions, they are temporary — as soon as you close a session and start a new one, the tool forgets everything you were just working on. item.title: OpenAI's acquisition of OpenClaw signals the beginning of the end of the ChatGPT era
item.description: The chatbot era may have just received its obituary. item.title: When accurate AI is still dangerously incomplete
item.description: Typically, when building, training and deploying AI, enterprises prioritize accuracy. And that, no doubt, is important; but in highly complex, nuanced industries like law, accuracy alone isn’t enough. Higher stakes mean higher standards: Models outputs must be assessed for relevancy, authority, citation accuracy and hallucination rates. item.title: New agent framework matches human-engineered AI systems — and adds zero inference cost to deploy
item.description: Agents built on top of today's models often break with simple changes — a new library, a workflow modification — and require a human engineer to fix it.
